questions.question: Which superhero do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Peter Parker got his powers from the bite of a special spider.

questions.question: Which superhero do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Batman has no superpowers at all, just gadgets, training and a very cool car.

questions.question: Which superhero do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Thor's hammer is called Mjolnir, and only the worthy can lift it.

questions.question: Which superhero do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Steve Rogers was turned into a super-soldier by a special serum during the Second World War.

questions.question: What is the name of Superman's home planet?
questions.explanation: Kryptonite, a glowing rock from his home planet, is the one thing that weakens him.

questions.question: What colour is the Hulk in the Marvel films?
questions.explanation: In his very first comic, in 1962, the Hulk was grey.

questions.question: What is Iron Man's real name?
questions.explanation: Tony Stark is a genius inventor who builds his own suits of armour.

questions.question: Which hidden African country does Black Panther rule?
questions.explanation: Wakanda hides its amazing technology by pretending to be a poor farming country.

questions.question: What does Wonder Woman's golden lasso force people to do?
questions.explanation: It's called the Lasso of Truth.

questions.question: Which villain wants all six Infinity Stones for his golden gauntlet?
questions.explanation: With all six stones, he snaps his fingers at the end of Avengers: Infinity War.

questions.question: In the Spider-Man films starring Tom Holland, what is the name of Peter Parker's best friend?
questions.explanation: Ned finds out Peter's secret when he spots him in his Spider-Man suit.

questions.question: In the X-Men comics and films, which metal covers Wolverine's skeleton and claws?
questions.explanation: In the Marvel world, adamantium is almost impossible to break.

questions.question: What is Captain Marvel's real name in the 2019 Marvel film?
questions.explanation: Her cat, Goose, turns out to be an alien called a Flerken.

questions.question: What is the name of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s giant flying aircraft carrier in The Avengers?
questions.explanation: It stays in the air using four enormous rotors.

questions.question: What is the name of Batman's loyal butler?
questions.explanation: Alfred Pennyworth has looked after Bruce Wayne since he was a boy.

questions.question: Which superhero do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Clint Barton is played by Jeremy Renner in the Marvel films.

questions.question: Which superhero do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: In the films he guards the Time Stone inside the Eye of Agamotto.

questions.question: Which Batman villain do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: The Joker first appeared in Batman #1 in 1940.

questions.question: Which actor played Tony Stark in the Marvel films?
questions.explanation: As he snaps his fingers in Avengers: Endgame, Tony says 'I am Iron Man', the same words that end his very first film.

questions.question: In which year did Iron Man launch the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
questions.explanation: Its after-credits scene introduced Nick Fury and the Avengers Initiative.

questions.question: In the first Iron Man film, what is the name of Tony Stark's computer assistant?
questions.explanation: J.A.R.V.I.S. later becomes part of Vision in Avengers: Age of Ultron.

questions.question: Which newspaper does Clark Kent work for?
questions.explanation: Lois Lane is a star reporter there too.

questions.question: In the comics, what was Wolverine's birth name?
questions.explanation: He has gone by the name Logan for most of his long life.

questions.question: Which writer co-created Spider-Man with the artist Steve Ditko?
questions.explanation: Spider-Man first appeared in Amazing Fantasy #15 in 1962.

questions.question: In Avengers: Infinity War, which Infinity Stone is hidden on the planet Vormir?
questions.explanation: It can only be won by giving up someone you love.

questions.question: What is the name of the axe Thor gets in Avengers: Infinity War?
questions.explanation: It was forged on Nidavellir by the dwarf king Eitri.

questions.question: Which DC hero is secretly Barry Allen?
questions.explanation: In the comics he gets his speed when lightning hits a shelf of chemicals in his lab.

questions.question: Who played Bruce Banner in The Avengers (2012)?
questions.explanation: Edward Norton had played the part in The Incredible Hulk four years earlier.

questions.question: What is the name of Thanos's home world in the Marvel films?
questions.explanation: In Infinity War, some of the Avengers fight him there among its ruins.

questions.question: What name does Peter Quill call himself in Guardians of the Galaxy?
questions.explanation: He keeps his mum's mixtape, Awesome Mix Vol. 1, playing on an old Walkman.
